about.title: About Yari Crochet
about.subtitle: The Art of Handmade Crochet
about.description: Welcome to my world of unique crochet and knit creations. I'm Yaritza Salgado Fina, a passionate artisan who transforms every thread into wearable art. Each piece I create tells a story, blending ancestral techniques with contemporary design.
about.quality: I'm committed to using only premium materials and maintaining the highest craftsmanship standards. Each piece is unique and made with love, especially for you.
about.portraitAlt: Portrait of Yaritza Salgado Fina, creator of Yari Crochet
about.cardLead: Yari Crochet is devoted to reviving the oldest crochet and knitting techniques, and retro fashion trends.
about.cardBody: With bold creations in boho chic, hippie, vintage and shabby chic styles, the brand sets new trends and celebrates creativity, imagination and handmade skill.
about.artisanTitle: Artisan at Heart, Creator of Dreams
about.paragraph1: Since childhood, I found in weaving not just a passion, but a way to connect with family traditions passed down through generations. With over 15 years of experience, I've perfected ancestral techniques that seemed to be lost in time.
about.paragraph2: My mission goes beyond creating beautiful crochet and knit pieces: I seek to revive the value of artisanal work in an era where handmade items are becoming increasingly precious and meaningful.
about.paragraph3: Each of my creations reflects not only technical skill, but also creativity, imagination, and manual dexterity - that ability that only comes with years of dedication and love for my craft.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions and Returns Policy
terms.subtitle: Yari Crochet

1.title: General Information
1.body: Yari Crochet is an online store dedicated to selling handmade, one-of-a-kind crochet pieces. By placing an order on our website, you agree to these terms and conditions.

2.title: Handmade Nature and Availability
2.body: Because our products are handmade, each piece is unique. Stock is updated in real time, but if two simultaneous purchases are made for a one-of-a-kind piece that has already been sold, we will contact the customer to offer a full refund or a similar alternative.

3.title: Shipping and Delivery Times
3.body: We ship domestically and internationally to the destinations enabled in our payment gateway. Delivery times vary depending on the recipient’s location and the selected carrier.

4.title: Returns and Refunds Policy
4.body: Due to the delicate, handmade nature of our garments, we do not accept exchanges or returns for a change of mind or incorrectly selected sizes, unless the product arrives with a verifiable manufacturing defect or has suffered serious damage during transport. In that case, the customer must notify us within 3 days of receipt, with photographic evidence.

5.title: Privacy and Data Protection
5.body: Your personal and payment data are processed securely through encrypted payment gateways (Stripe). We do not store sensitive credit or debit card information on our servers.

terms.contact: Questions? Write to us at {{email}} or through the contact section.
terms.shippingLink: See also our shipping policy and rates.
